caseName: Fiallo ex rel. Rodriguez v. Levi
caseNameFull: Fiallo, a minor, by Rodriguez v. Levi, Attorney General

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. E. D. N. Y. Motion, of appellants for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted. Case set for oral argument with No. 75-5952 [Trimble v. Gordon, probable jurisdiction noted, 424 Ü. S. 964],
